extracted.intended_audience: potential subscribers / app users (people evaluating the Dropout app listing) and app reviewers
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria and metadata shown on an App Store product page for a comedy streaming app (Dropout) used to evaluate the app's content, pricing, privacy, compatibility, and UX. Useful for users deciding whether to subscribe and for product teams comparing App Store expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription & in-app purchases / pricing
rubrics_metrics.description: To access all features and content you can subscribe to DROPOUT By CollegeHumor on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app purchases: Monthly $6.99, Annual $69.99. All payments will be paid through your Apple Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Free trial terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Download the app and sign up for a trial of 3 free-as-heck days to watch everything your eyes can handle. Cancel anytime in the 3 day trial and never be charged!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. The first month will automatically begin at the end of the free trial unless cancelled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content scope and release cadence
rubrics_metrics.description: New original series like Dimension 20, Game Changer, Um Actually, Breaking News, What the F 101, Ultramechatron Team Go, Bad Internet, and more. Weekly releases of new episodes, including Dimension 20, Adventuring Party, Game Changer, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights that the app provides original, exclusive content you won't find anywhere else — all uncensored and ad-free — and that talent includes named performers. Emphasizes regular (weekly) content additions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ad-free / uncensored content expectation
rubrics_metrics.description: Exclusive content you won't find anywhere else - all uncensored and ad-free - with talent like Brennan Lee Mulligan, Sam Reich, Zac Oyama, Emily Axford, Ally Beardsley, Lou Wilson, Aabria Iyengar, Erika Ishii, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positions ad-free and uncensored presentation as a key selling point and quality criterion for subscribers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Age rating and content descriptors
rubrics_metrics.description: This app has an age rating of 16+ with content restrictions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content descriptors include profanity or crude humor, mature or suggestive themes, infrequent cartoon or fantasy violence, alcohol/tobacco/drug references, sexual content or nudity. Access is managed by the developer through in-app controls.

rubrics_metrics.name: In-app controls / age assurance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Developer-managed controls determine access to content; the listing states which controls are present or used to manage age/content access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Platform compatibility & technical requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Size 51.8 MB. iPhone, iPad, Apple TV. Requires iOS 15.0 or later (iPhone, iPod touch), iPadOS 15.0 or later (iPad), tvOS 15.0 or later (Apple TV), visionOS 1.0 or later (Apple Vision).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: App metadata must declare supported devices, minimum OS versions, app download size, and languages (English and 4 more: French, German, Portuguese, Spanish).

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility disclosure and support
rubrics_metrics.description: The developer has not yet indicated which accessibility features this app supports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: User reviews praise captions and audio descriptions ('captions ... get the *vibes* of the content', 'Audio descriptions are funny and accurate') — implying that accurate captions and thoughtful audio descriptions are important accessibility and quality criteria that should be declared and implemented.

rubrics_metrics.name: App functionality & UX features
rubrics_metrics.description: Feature notes from version history: 'Speed controls on videos' and 'Filter search results to find the exact right video'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: User feedback calls out desired UX features: ability to remove items from Recents, ordering/grouping downloads, mass delete for downloads, non-autoplay episode landing pages (to read descriptions), discoverable short-span rewind controls, and better captions handling. Good UX includes intuitive playback controls, search/filtering, download management, and non-intrusive navigation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search quality & discoverability
rubrics_metrics.description: The search function isn't particularly 'function'al; could be improved with semantic search using vector embeddings to return episodes and matching timestamps (per user review).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-quality search should return relevant episodes and timestamps for specific moments, improving discoverability of content ('The part with Chungledown Bim' should return the matching timestamps).

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy practices & data handling transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: The developer indicated that the app’s privacy practices may include handling of data as described below. This information has not been verified by Apple.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data Linked to You may include: Location (Coarse), Contact Info (Email Address, Name), Identifiers (User ID, Device ID), Analytics, User Content, Customer Support, Purchases, Purchase History. Data Not Linked to You may include: Usage Data, Advertising Data, Search History, Crash Data, Performance Data, Other Diagnostic Data. The listing should link to the developer's privacy policy and clarify uses (developer’s advertising/marketing, analytics, product personalization, app functionality, diagnostics).

rubrics_metrics.name: Release notes & maintenance cadence
rubrics_metrics.description: Version history entries repeatedly list '* Bug fixes' and '* Performance improvements' across many releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regular updates with bug fixes and performance improvements are expected; feature releases (e.g., speed controls) may be noted in specific version entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developer legal & metadata links
rubrics_metrics.description: Terms of Service: https://watch.dropout.tv/tos  Privacy Policy: https://watch.dropout.tv/privacy  Developer Website listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: App listing must provide links to Terms of Service and Privacy Policy and display developer/copyright information (©2025 Connected Ventures, LLC).

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages & localization
rubrics_metrics.description: Languages: English and 4 more (English, French, German, Portuguese, Spanish).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listing should state supported languages; localization influences accessibility and user reach.

rubrics_metrics.name: User review signals as quality criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: User reviews emphasize content quality ('This App Saved My Life', 'Love the content'), but often flag UX shortcomings (recents management, download ordering, search, accessibility), naming these as deciding factors for continued use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviews should be considered part of the evaluation rubric: quality of content (humor, emotional value), reliability of playback and app functionality, accessibility, and usability all matter to prospective subscribers.
